text: マリオが　バケツを　かぶって　あるいて　いく　ゲームだ！

structure.jp: マリオが　バケツを　かぶって
structure.en: Mario, with a bucket on his head,

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: マリオが　バケツを　かぶって　あるいて　いく　ゲーム
patterns.explanation: A whole phrase ending in a verb sits right before a noun and tells you which kind of thing it is. マリオが　バケツを　かぶって　あるいて　いく　ゲーム = 'a game where Mario walks along with a bucket on his head'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb says the action keeps going onward, away from here. あるいて　いく = 'walks along'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next. Here the first one is the state he is in while doing the second. バケツを　かぶって　あるいて　いく = 'walks along with a bucket on his head'.
